question: What reward comes to one who recites this text with loving devotion to Bagalā?
premises: Someone recites this text with love.
The recitation is directed in the context of Bagalā.
inference: Loving recitation of this text secures the affection of Bagalā for the reciter.
uncertainties: etiḥ appears as a nonstandard form of eti
plain_english: Whoever indeed recites this with love attains the affection of Bagalā.
